content: देशीय {%a.%} [देशे भवः -छ] .²1 Belonging to a province, provincial. .²2 Native, local. .²3 Inhabiting any country (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); as in मगधदेशीय, तद्देशीय, वङ्गदेशीय <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 Not far or distant from, almost, bordering on (used as affix at the end of words); अष्टादशवर्षदेशीयां कन्यां ददर्श <ls>K. 131</ls>; ‘a girl about 18 years old (whose age bordered on 18)’; षङ्वर्षदेशीयमपि प्रभुत्वात् प्रैक्षन्त पौराः पितृगौरवेण <ls>R. 18. 39</ls>; so पटुदेशीय <ab>&c.</ab>
